value.message: Halton Hills Gymnastics Centre runs Parent and Tot (18 months-3.11 yrs) Sept 12-Dec 18, and a Pre-school Drop In Tue/Thu 9:30-12, $15 - their site says. Gellert has drop-in swim lessons Tue or Thu 10:00-10:30, Sept 22-Dec 29, per the Town. I couldn't confirm the class day or swim price; I'll keep watching.
